scope: Metadata repair assumed; calibration, adapted lowering, generation, candidate replay and confirmation API usage only.

api_checks.finding: Matches LoweredQuery.columns containing QueryColumn(name: Identifier, sort: ScalarSort).
row_count is an integer property. rows(RelationId) returns tuple rows expanded by multiplicity, so list(...) preserves the full finite bag and all columns.

Adapter receives the real TypeKind enum and installs the expected two-argument callable on the same Catalog dialect used by lowering and generation; context spans both. Original f incompatibility remains recorded separately.
All fields exist; Status is a string Enum with sat/unsat/unknown/unsupported values.

api_checks.call: GenerationConfig(timeout_ms, time_limit_s, seed, speculate, set_semantics); generate(sql, catalog, config=..., on_attempt=..., on_instance=...)
api_checks.finding: Constructor keywords and callback signatures match. GenerationResult has instance, nonempty, reached, covered, unsupported, timed_out and failed property. Optional instance is guarded before rows extraction.

api_checks.call: Independent native Python value checks before psycopg2 insertion
api_checks.finding: Default official provider uses Python bool/int/str/date/naive datetime for these selected native types; Instance extraction preserves the carriers. No static DATE/TIMESTAMP-to-string mismatch identified.

author_logic_corrections_for_v3.issue: on_instance returning False means continue generation, not reject or roll back an already accepted upstream instance. Invalid candidate or backend error currently returns False.
author_logic_corrections_for_v3.candidate_fix: Record the failed candidate and terminate this bounded admission attempt using a distinct exception/outcome; preserve INVALID_CANDIDATE or BACKEND_REPLAY_ERROR as final status. Do not treat False as generator pruning. Do not return True and then interpret upstream nonempty as successful admission.

author_logic_corrections_for_v3.issue: A confirmed difference with empty AFTER results is recorded on the candidate but final status falls through to NO_NONEMPTY.
author_logic_corrections_for_v3.candidate_fix: Classify confirmed result difference first, confirmed nonempty AFTER second, then explicit invalid/error/unsupported/budget outcomes, and only then ordinary no-nonempty observation. A difference requires successful fullC acceptance and both original queries succeeding in both databases.

author_logic_corrections_for_v3.issue: The speculative seed callback can stop before query execution/coverage, returning GenerationResult(seed, True) with empty reached/covered. A time limit before execution can likewise report bool(seed.row_count).
author_logic_corrections_for_v3.candidate_fix: Keep using actual PostgreSQL AFTER result nonemptiness and independent confirmation as admission evidence. Label generator.nonempty as upstream telemetry; empty coverage on callback early stop is not a mechanism failure. Preserve result.unsupported as an explicit unsupported outcome.

confirmation_review.finding: Replays explicitly insert all source columns in parent-before-child table order, then execute both original SQL strings. A new database and connection receive the same DDL and data, and the result dictionaries are compared. This confirmation logic does not call a nonexistent ParSEval API.
confirmation_review.limits: Backend permissions, timeout sufficiency, DDL acceptance and actual query results require the separately authorized execution; none were tested here. Full117-column/43-C scope and original query bytes must remain unchanged.

conclusion: Static API alignment supports preparing v3 without further speculative signature changes. The identified callback/result-classification fixes should prevent misleading outcomes. No successful admission, generation, replay, equivalence or novelty result is claimed.
